title: Next.js 16 App Router Component Scaffold
prompt_content: Generate a production-ready Next.js 16 Client Component named `{{ComponentName}}` in TypeScript. It must include async server action handlers, accessible ARIA attributes, Tailwind CSS layout, and a loading skeleton.
description: Scaffolds a robust Next.js 16 component with server actions and TypeScript types.

title: Edge JWT Authentication Guard
prompt_content: Write a lightweight Next.js Edge Middleware for route `{{RoutePath}}` that extracts the Bearer token, validates the JWT with `jose`, handles expired claims with redirect to `{{LoginPath}}`, and injects custom header `x-user-id`.
description: Zero-dependency Edge middleware pattern for JWT verification.

title: PostgreSQL Query Plan Optimizer
prompt_content: Analyze the following PostgreSQL query and its EXPLAIN ANALYZE output: `{{QueryText}}`. Identify index scans, sequential scans, buffer hits, and recommend missing indexes or CTE optimizations.
description: Identifies slow database scans and suggests index & CTE refinements.

title: WCAG Compliant Color Palette Generator
prompt_content: /palette Generate a 5-color dark-mode palette around primary hex `{{PrimaryHex}}`. Ensure contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 against #0f172a. Return Tailwind `theme.extend.colors` config.
description: Generates WCAG AA/AAA compliant color scales for dark and light themes.
